consequence.statement: The `enabled` value is now honoured to toggle cert-manager on or off as a chart dependency, so values that already set `enabled: false` (previously without this effect) will now toggle cert-manager off.
consequence.remediation: Check whether any values files (including parent/umbrella charts) set `enabled`; if cert-manager should still be installed, set `enabled: true` or remove the key.

assertion.statement: The cert-manager 1.17.0 Helm chart now allows the `enabled` value to be set, toggling cert-manager on or off when it is installed as a chart dependency.
